title: Demonstration of Integrated Solenoid Transformer Balun in Glass Substrate Utilizing TGVs
notes: IMAPS 2024 Symposium, Boston; manual download. Marchand solenoid transformer balun in 400 um Boro-33 glass with 30 um LMCE TGVs and 2 Cu/ABF RDLs per side; S-parameters 1-5 GHz.

title: Process Development for a Novel Low Loss and Non-PFAS Photo Imageable Dielectric for RF Silicon Interposer Applications
notes: 2024 International 3D Systems Integration Conference. 300 mm RF Si interposer: Cu damascene ground plane, CYCLOTENE XP80 PID with Cu pillars, 2 SAP RDLs, UBM; warpage, TTV, leakage, 20-170 GHz microstrip loss.

title: Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) Diamond-filled Through Vias for Enhanced Vertical Heat Transport in 3D Heterogeneous Integration
orgs: University of California, Los Angeles; Instituto de Telecomunicações, University of Aveiro; CICECO - Aveiro Institute of Materials, University of Aveiro
notes: Hot-filament CVD polycrystalline diamond liners in via-first DRIE TSVs (10/15/20 um, AR up to 5:1) over SiO2/Ti; SEM/EDX thickness profiles. Cu fill proposed, not built; no thermal measurement.
